The fatigue is described as bone-weary tiredness that worsens by midday, causing the patient to struggle to keep their eyes open. The patient has no changes in swallowing, breathing, weight loss, fever, night sweats, or appetite. They report no significant stressors or lifestyle changes. The patient takes occasional allergy medication. The plan is to start with blood work (CBC) and potentially CT scan if needed.
